source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, as amended (incl. the 2017 amendment and the Second Amendment Rules, 2022)
note: This table is the single source of truth for every check the engine performs. Amending a rule means editing this file - no Python changes. A legal SME should validate it against the currently notified Rules before any enforcement use.

mandatory_fields.label: Name & complete address of manufacturer / packer / importer
mandatory_fields.plain: Every retail pack must carry the name and full address of whoever made, packed or imported it.

mandatory_fields.label: Common or generic name of the commodity
mandatory_fields.plain: The pack must say what the product actually is, in plain language.

mandatory_fields.label: Net quantity in standard units
mandatory_fields.plain: The quantity inside must be stated in standard metric units.

mandatory_fields.label: Retail sale price as 'Maximum Retail Price ... inclusive of all taxes'
mandatory_fields.plain: The maximum retail price must be printed, and it must say it already includes all taxes.

mandatory_fields.label: Month & year of manufacture / packing / import
mandatory_fields.plain: The pack must show the month and year it was made, packed or imported.

mandatory_fields.label: Consumer care contact (name, address, phone / email)
mandatory_fields.plain: There must be a way to reach the company if something is wrong with the pack.

mandatory_fields.label: Country of origin
mandatory_fields.plain: Imported packs must name the country the goods came from.

mandatory_fields.label: Unit sale price, where required
mandatory_fields.plain: Larger packs should also show the price per standard unit so shoppers can compare.

font_height_table_mm.note: Tolerance absorbs OCR box and calibration error, so a declaration is only flagged when it is clearly below the minimum rather than marginally so.

commodity_name_reject_note: Phrases that must never be read as the commodity's generic name even when they are the tallest text left standing. Nutrition-table headers and other boilerplate are often the most prominent type on a back panel; matching them produced findings like 'Energy' as a product name.

exemptions.description: Packages of net quantity below 10 g or 10 ml (other than tobacco) are exempt from most declarations.
Packages above 25 kg / 25 litre (50 kg for cement and fertiliser) are wholesale packages governed by a different chapter.
Electronic products may carry certain descriptive declarations via QR code instead of printing them on the pack.

cross_field_rules.description: MRP is declared but the mandatory 'inclusive of all taxes' qualifier was not found.
A principal declaration is printed below the minimum height for this pack size.

The GS1 company prefix in the barcode was issued outside India while the pack declares Indian origin, or vice versa. Not an offence by itself - GS1 prefixes indicate where the number was licensed, not where goods were made - but a documented mismatch worth verifying at inspection.
The pack identifies an importer but declares no country of origin.
The declared month and year of manufacture is later than the date of inspection.
Capture quality was too poor for the reading to be relied on; the operator was asked to retake rather than being given an uncertain verdict.
cross_field_rules.citation: Operational control, not a statutory rule
